payload.reason: The evidence describes how IPA systems interact with users and accumulate structured and labeled training data through these interactions.

claims.text: IPA systems interact with users to gather information and simultaneously accumulate structured and labeled training data.
User interactions allow IPA systems to automatically label dialogues with corresponding next actions and dialogue IDs without additional post-labeling.
The structured dialogues collected from user interactions can be used to train dialogue management components using machine learning techniques.
